lens.payload:
{
  "score": 5,
  "findings": [
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/runner.sh",
      "category": "logic",
      "severity": "high",
      "line": 3204,
      "message": "`_cycle_dispatch` emits `stage.start` for every cycle member dispatch where `_cd_iter > 0` without a `_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE` guard, so on every fresh cycle-based run each cycle member now emits a `stage.start` event — a change to the event contract the design explicitly prohibited for non-resume paths.",
      "quote": "if [[ \"$_cd_iter\" -gt 0 ]]; then",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    },
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh",
      "category": "logic",
      "severity": "high",
      "line": 2333,
      "message": "The design decision states the `stage.start` guard in `_cycle_dispatch` must be `if [[ ${_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE:-false} == true ]] && [[ \"$_cd_iter\" -gt 0 ]]`, but the cycle orchestrator already sets `_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE=false` here before it ever calls `_cycle_dispatch`, so that proposed guard would suppress `stage.start` for cycle members even during resume — the design decision and the DSPK-1/FSTG-1 requirements are inconsistent with each other, and the implementation silently chose one side (emit always) without resolving the conflict.",
      "quote": "_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE=false",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "design"
    },
    {
      "file": "tests/integration/resume-rehydrate-test.sh",
      "category": "coverage",
      "severity": "medium",
      "line": 718,
      "message": "The FRSH-2 fresh-run sub-case only asserts that `intake` emits exactly one `stage.start`; it never asserts that cycle members do NOT emit `stage.start` on a fresh run, so the spurious `stage.start` emission introduced by finding 1 passes the guard undetected.",
      "quote": "assert_eq \"fresh run dispatches intake (not skipped; ADR-050 §6 new-run side)\" \\",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "test"
    },
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/runner.sh",
      "category": "logic",
      "severity": "medium",
      "line": 1735,
      "message": "When both `resume_mode=true` and `from_stage` is set, `_artifact_persist_restore` is called twice: first inside `_runner_resume_rehydrate` at line ~2897, then again here inside `_runner_from_stage_preflight`. Both failures are silently swallowed (`|| true`), so a git-state-branch read failure leaves the preflight to report \"has no restorable primary artifact\" with no prior indication of why restoration actually failed.",
      "quote": "_artifact_persist_restore \"$_fsp_issue\" \"$_fsp_staging\" || true",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    },
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/runner.sh",
      "category": "logic",
      "severity": "low",
      "line": 2905,
      "message": "`pipeline.skip_to_stage` is still emitted on the `--resume --from-stage` path; the original issue identified this event being emitted and nothing acting on it as a bug, and while the fix correctly makes stages skip, the event name still misrepresents what actually occurs now that `_runner_from_stage_preflight` rehydrates artifacts from the git state branch before dispatch.",
      "quote": "eb_emit_event \"pipeline.skip_to_stage\" \"stage=$from_stage\" \"run_id=$_runner_run_id\"",
      "introduced": false,
      "fix": "code"
    }
  ]
}
